result.brief: 提出无假阳性统计检验，用于判定视频Transformer（VideoMAE、V-JEPA2、TimeSformer）特征是否真正编码时序概念，并借助SAE特征与合成表征空间验证其特异性。
result.reason: Analyzes temporal concept encoding in VideoMAE, V-JEPA2, TimeSformer video representations with a statistical feature test, directly contributing to video representation learning analysis.
